my-work.title: My work
my-work.intro: Tasks assigned to your human resource in the current project.
my-work.query_length: Use at most 200 characters and no null characters.
my-work.live_scope: Counts cover all matching tasks, including pages not loaded. Status filters keep the same search. Refresh to read current assignments; inspect execution and review evidence in task details.
my-work.unbound.title: Connect your human resource
my-work.unbound.hint: Your account is not linked to a human resource in this project. Open project resources to check the account link.
my-work.inactive.title: Your human resource is inactive
my-work.inactive.hint: Tasks are hidden while the linked human resource is inactive. Open project resources to check its status.
my-work.empty.title: No tasks assigned to you
my-work.empty.hint: Tasks assigned to your current human resource will appear here. Refresh after assignments change.
my-work.filtered.title: No tasks match these filters
my-work.filtered.hint: Try another search or clear the filters to see your assigned tasks.
my-work.access_cleared: Private task and resource details have been cleared. Retry to check your current access.
my-work.invalid_read: Your current task queue could not be confirmed. Refresh to read it again.
my-work.page_changed: Your assignments changed while loading. Refresh to start from the first page.
